prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1421; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Houston, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: Sure. I'd rather not put my full name on it, so just call me the claimant.

Q: That's acceptable for the file. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was backing out of a space near the store entrance. It was a busy afternoon and the lot was crowded.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?

A: Not right away. I checked my mirror, saw nothing behind me, and started reversing. Then I felt a bump on the driver's side rear.

Q: How fast were you moving when that happened?

A: Slowly, maybe walking pace. I was barely rolling.

Q: Did you stop after the impact, and what did you do next?

A: I stopped immediately. I got out, looked at both cars, and exchanged information with the other driver. Then I sat in my car for a few minutes because my neck started to ache.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that day. They said I had a neck strain and a lower back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Have you had any problems with neck or back pain before this collision?

A: Nothing serious. I had some stiffness now and then from sitting at a desk, but I never had to see a doctor for it.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that the pain has made it hard to sleep and I've missed a few days of work. I'm still getting treatment, and I'm hoping to get back to normal soon.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
